chunks: 4994 - Shuʿayb narrated from Abū Baṣīr, who said: Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام said:
ʿAlī عليه السلام ruled concerning a man who married another man's wife that he stoned the woman and administered the prescribed legal punishment to the man.
And he عليه السلام said: If I had known that you knew, I would have crushed your head with stones.

key_terms.تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةَ رَجُلٍ: to marry a woman who was already another man's wife
key_terms.رَجَمَ: to stone as a legal punishment
key_terms.لَفَضَخْتُ رَأْسَكَ بِالْحِجَارَةِ: I would have crushed your head with stones

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام rule about a man who married another man's wife?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a judicial ruling from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding a man who married a woman already married to another man. It distinguishes between the legal consequences for the woman and the man, and indicates that knowing involvement in such a case would have warranted a harsher punishment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4994 - Shuayb narrated from Abu Baṣir who said that Abu Jafar (as) said:
"Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) ruled in the case of a man who married another man's wife, that the woman should be stoned, and the man should be given the prescribed punishment (for fornication).
Imam (as) then said: 'If I knew that you were aware (that she was already married), I would have crushed your head with stones.'"
